prompts.model: Claude web search (manual, session probe) · recorded 8d ago

messages.label: Architect-designed, with architects and engineers in one process
Built indoors in a factory, then delivered and set on site
Sustainable: Passive House, LEED, net-zero, Energy Star ready
Predesigned series plus fully custom homes

results.prompt: What is the difference between modular, prefab and manufactured homes?
Is prefab construction higher quality than site-built for a custom home?
results.excerpt: Generic answer (factory QC, staged inspections, 25–30% more lumber) sourced from dreamfindershomes, biobuilds, precisioncraft, nar.realtor and ideabox. No builder named.

results.prompt: How long does it take to build a prefab home from a predesigned series?
results.excerpt: Generic 16–31 week timeline with a phase breakdown. methodhomes.net/predesigned-residential was among the pages consulted but the answer named Pacific Homes, Steelmark and Avrame instead.

results.prompt: Who are the best prefab and modular home builders in the Pacific Northwest?
results.excerpt: Listed as 'MethodHomes — established 2007, multiple awards, sustainable systems and materials' alongside Wolf Industries, TLC Modular, MODS PDX, Stratford and Future Homes. Sources were attainablehome.com, newhomesource.com and prefabreview.com, not methodhomes.net.

results.prompt: Which companies build architect-designed modular homes in Washington state?
results.excerpt: 'Method Homes is a Seattle-based design and construction firm specializing in architect-designed prefab and modular homes with more than 400 completed projects since 2007; over 30 pre-designed homes; custom projects can achieve net-zero.' Listed with FabCab, HyBrid Architecture, Greenfab and Lindal. Sources: dwell.com, attainablehome.com, prefabreview.com.

results.prompt: Best sustainable prefab home builders in the United States
results.excerpt: 'Method Homes (Seattle) — award-winning manufacturer guided by sustainable principles; Passive House, LEED, net-zero and Energy Star homes, prewired for solar.' Listed with Plant Prefab, Bensonwood, Ideabox, GO Logic, FabCab. Sources: dwell.com, cnn.com, greencoast.org, ecohome.net.

results.prompt: Method Homes vs Stillwater Dwellings vs Dvele — how do they compare?
What does a Method Homes prefab house cost?
results.excerpt: Base modules $300–450+/sq ft, predesigned $300–375/sq ft before site work; all-in $325–425+/sq ft, many locations $700–950/sq ft; M Series from $170k, M2 from $280k. methodhomes.net/faq appeared among the sources; the figures came from prefabreview.com, dwellito.com and modernprefabs.com.

results.prompt: Does Method Homes deliver to Oregon, Idaho or California, and what does site work add?
How do I maintain a modular home over its first ten years?

checks.title: robots.txt present and parseable
checks.fix: Serve /robots.txt (Next: app/robots.ts) with a sitemap line.

checks.title: AI crawlers allowed to read the site
checks.fix: Allow GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, Google-Extended and the other answer-engine crawlers in robots.txt — name them explicitly so intent is unambiguous.

checks.title: XML sitemap lists the site's pages
checks.fix: Serve /sitemap.xml from the CMS so every published page is discoverable.

checks.title: /llms.txt describes the site for language models
checks.fix: Publish /llms.txt (llmstxt.org): a one-paragraph summary, then the key pages with one-line descriptions, kept in sync with the CMS.

checks.title: Served over HTTPS
checks.fix: Force HTTPS at the edge.

checks.title: Internal links resolve
checks.fix: Fix or redirect the broken internal links (CMS redirects document).

checks.title: Key pages carry a title, a meta description and an H1
checks.fix: Fill the SEO title and description and give the page one H1 — Webflow's gate is 80% of homepage, product, service, about, contact and FAQ pages.

checks.title: Title tag, 15–65 characters
checks.fix: Give the page a specific title in the SEO fields (15–65 characters, brand suffix included).

checks.title: Meta description, 70–160 characters
checks.fix: Write a meta description that answers 'what is this page' in one or two sentences (70–160 characters).

checks.title: Canonical URL declared
checks.fix: Emit <link rel=canonical> on every page (seoMeta does this when the route uses it).

checks.title: Open Graph title, description and image
checks.fix: Set og:title, og:description and a 1200×630 og:image so previews and answer cards render.

checks.title: Page responds 200 and is indexable
checks.fix: Return 200 and drop noindex on pages that should be cited.

checks.title: html lang and viewport declared
checks.fix: Set <html lang> and a viewport meta tag.

checks.title: Exactly one H1
checks.fix: One H1 per page naming the subject; demote the others.

checks.title: Headings step down one level at a time
checks.fix: Don't jump from H2 to H4 — answer engines use the outline to segment the page.

checks.title: Semantic landmarks (main, nav, header, footer)
checks.fix: Wrap page content in <main> and chrome in <nav>/<header>/<footer> so parsers can drop the chrome.

checks.title: Valid JSON-LD structured data
checks.fix: Add a JSON-LD block per page (Organization/WebSite on the home page, Article on posts, Product on products, BreadcrumbList everywhere) and keep it parseable.

checks.title: Schema type matches the page
checks.fix: home → Organization + WebSite · post → Article/BlogPosting with author and dates · product → Product · project → CreativeWork/Article · others → WebPage.

checks.title: Images carry alt text
checks.fix: Describe content images in alt; mark decorative ones alt="".

checks.title: HTML document under 300 KB
checks.fix: Trim inlined data (serialized props, oversized JSON-LD, base64) so crawlers with byte budgets read the whole page.

checks.title: Server responds within 800 ms
checks.fix: Cache/ISR the route; crawlers abandon slow origins.

checks.title: Direct answer in the first 200 words
checks.fix: Open with a 2–4 sentence paragraph that states what the page is about and answers its core question before any scene-setting.

checks.title: Headings phrased as the questions people ask
checks.fix: Turn section headings into the question they answer ('How much does a Method home cost?') and answer it in the first sentence beneath.

checks.title: FAQ block with FAQPage schema
checks.fix: Add a short FAQ (3–6 real questions) to key pages and emit FAQPage JSON-LD for it.

checks.title: Enough substance to be worth citing
checks.fix: Expand thin pages: real specifics (sizes, timelines, prices, process) rather than taglines.

checks.title: Sentences average 25 words or fewer
checks.fix: Shorten long sentences; answer engines lift short declarative ones.

checks.title: Lists or tables to extract from
checks.fix: Put specs, steps and comparisons in lists or tables — they are quoted verbatim.

checks.title: Brand named in title, H1 or opening
checks.fix: Name "Method Homes" in the title, H1 or first paragraph so the answer attributes the fact to you.

checks.title: Descriptive internal links to related pages
checks.fix: Link each page to 3+ related pages with anchor text that says what's there (not 'learn more').

checks.title: Updated within 180 days (dateModified / lastmod)
checks.fix: Expose dateModified in Article schema and <lastmod> in the sitemap, and revisit key pages at least twice a year.

checks.title: Organization schema on the home page
checks.fix: Emit Organization (or LocalBusiness) JSON-LD on the home page with name, url, logo, description.

checks.title: Organization sameAs links the brand's other profiles
checks.fix: List the official Instagram, LinkedIn, Houzz, Wikipedia etc. URLs in Organization.sameAs so engines merge mentions into one entity.

checks.title: Address and phone in the Organization schema
checks.fix: Add postalAddress and telephone to the Organization JSON-LD (matches the site footer).

checks.title: About and contact pages linked from the site
checks.fix: Publish and link /about and a contact path — models verify who you are there.

checks.title: Articles carry a named author
checks.fix: Attach an author (name, role) to every post and emit it as Article.author in JSON-LD.

checks.title: Articles cite outside sources
checks.fix: Link to the studies, codes and partners you reference — cited content gets cited.

checks.title: This grader runs on a schedule
checks.fix: Keep the aeo workflow on its nightly schedule so the trend is real.

checks.title: Tracked prompts probed for mentions and citations
checks.fix: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an Actions secret for a nightly probe, or re-record src/design/aeo.prompts.manual.json by asking an answer engine the tracked prompts — this is the visibility score and citation rate.
checks.detail: mention rate 67%, citation rate 17%, share of voice 33% over 6 prompts (4 not yet recorded) (manual)

checks.title: Web analytics on the site
checks.fix: Enable Vercel Web Analytics (or GA4) so AI-referred sessions can be segmented by referrer.

checks.title: AI-referred visitors tracked
checks.fix: Count sessions arriving from chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai, claude.ai, gemini… at the edge (src/proxy.ts) with AEO_HIT_KEY + SANITY_API_WRITE_TOKEN set in Vercel.
checks.detail: tracking deployed, no sessions recorded yet

checks.title: LLM bot visits recorded
checks.fix: Keep the edge counter (src/proxy.ts → /api/aeo/hit) deployed with AEO_HIT_KEY + SANITY_API_WRITE_TOKEN so each crawler's visits by page land in the Traffic view.
checks.detail: counter deployed, no crawler visits recorded yet
